note: ערק is the consonantal base of the gentilic. The genealogy supplies no verbal etymology.
summary: עַרְקִי designates a member of the Arkite clan. In the genealogy of Canaan, the definite singular names the clan as a whole.

senses.definition: A member of the Arkite clan among Canaan’s descendants. The definite singular refers collectively to the Arkites.

evidence.note: The Arkites appear between the Hivites and Sinites in a list identified as the clans of the Canaanites.
The parallel genealogy repeats the same three gentilic nouns in the same order.
